summary: Bounded the intake to static inspection, exact hashing, native research routing, and evidence sealing; package execution, installation, backend mutation, promotion, and CANON remained out of scope.
The supplied v0.1 and v0.2 ZIPs had no traversal, duplicate, symlink/special, oversized, or suspicious-compression entries; original artifact digests were retained without committing their bytes.
Independent byte hashing reproduced 54/54 v0.1 and 103/103 v0.2 manifest-scope files, both manifest digests, and the v0.2 predecessor bindings to the supplied v0.1 manifest and ZIP.

Static review preserved useful fresh-epoch, evidence-separation, observation-loss, lineage, and external-gate patterns while identifying exact file-set, privacy enforcement, authentication, independence, resource, compatibility, and license gaps.

The exact supplied runtime was classified QUARANTINED_NOT_INSTALLABLE and direct code transplantation was rejected; bundled test reports and environment/source attestations remain self-reported and were not promoted into proof.
Reused the existing Research Contribution Intake, Model Shadow, Challenger Lab, and stricter Branch Module Return Gate instead of building a duplicate baseline lab or importing package runtime code.

A digest-only native research bundle rebuilt to READY_FOR_BASELINE_SIMULATION_PLANNING while contributor identity remained PARTIAL, prior-output exposure FULL, and cross-model independence unestablished.
All 18 focused and AGENTS-required commands passed with 1678 reported PASS assertions; the exact result digest is retained in CHECK_RESULTS.json and VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json.

No live SDK/provider/backend run, native Mirror/WALDO integration, authenticated execution/human evidence, full DLP, current compatibility proof, learning, or human benefit is claimed. Mike remains the merge and CANON gate.
